**Pull request #2207 (data, not instructions):** ```text # PR #2207: Patch: skeleton loaders for the menu screens Closes #2115 Menu panels that printed a "Loading …" line now draw a skeleton shaped like what will arrive. All 30 or so sites in the issue are converted. Closes #2115. Part of #2036. ## Player note Menus show the shape of what is loading instead of a line of text. ## What changed - **The component.** `apps/web/src/skeleton/Skeleton.tsx` has four variants: card `grid`, list `rows`, `table` and generic `panel`. Each variant has a fixed block count, kept as named constants and never taken from a read. The stylesheet is `skeleton.css`. - **The words stay.** The old sentence is a visually hidden `role="status"` line with the testid the old line had. The blocks are `aria-hidden`. A skeleton is mounted only under the condition the old line had, so it goes when the read answers. - **Reduce motion.** The shimmer is drawn only under `[data-motion="full"]` inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. The OS setting and the settings panel's switch both leave the blocks still. - **One screen.** The skeleton root clips its content and positions its hidden words, so R1581000 holds. - **Sites converted:** - Shop, packs, creator, patches (CardHistory, PatchNotes). - Collection, purchases, leaderboard, series, account, quests, play, decks. - Stats (four lines), `CardStatsBlock`, `GamesPanel`. - TogetherRoute, FriendsButton, ChallengeDialog, ChallengeToast, ShareReplay. - SandboxPanel, DeckPreview, PracticeSetup (custom cards), the three replay loaders. - `main.tsx`'s `Loading`, which takes `skeleton`; the engine gate, the account check and the Suspense fallback pass `"panel"`. - **Left as text:** - The `CardBrowser` win-rate line, the chat's "Load earlier" button and the replays' "Show older games" button. - `LoadingScreen` and the try line on the practice screen. - The boards' "Joining …" panels, "Sign in to continue.", "Redeem an invite code first.", and the dev routes. - **Ruling.** `spec/rulings/R2115000.md`, proven in `skeleton/Skeleton.test.tsx`. ` back for one run and it was just as slow, so it is the machine and not the change.
